notes.title: Devlog #1 – Spin, Collect, Conquer
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! We’re excited to introduce [b]Spin Royale[/b], our upcoming idle slot-style game where every spin can bring you new rewards, upgrades, and surprises.[/p][p]In Spin Royale, the reels spin automatically at the bottom of your screen. Your job isn’t to pull the lever—it’s to make smart choices with what you earn.[/p][p][/p][p]🔹 [b]Feature Spotlight – Automatic Spins[/b][/p][list][*][p]Spins happen continuously in the background.
[/p][/*][*][p]Rare symbols trigger unique bonuses.
[/p][/*][*][p]You can jump in anytime to claim rewards and decide where to invest.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628556/8e65f9942a4e7baa8a3519425a13d484e2fbb0a4.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s the perfect blend of [b]luck and strategy[/b]—easy to play in short bursts, but with depth for those who want to chase the leaderboards.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Wishlist Spin Royale on [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3737550/Spin_Royale/"]Steam[/url][b] today and join our [/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/DbtDSuxkHx"]Discord[/url][b] to follow the journey![/b][/p][p]

notes.title: Announcement Trailer and Demo Release!
notes.notes:
We are so proud to announce the demo of our new game: Spin Royale!

[previewyoutube=adXhqAysKu4;full][/previewyoutube]

Spin Royale is a bottom-of-screen idle game where your slot machine spins and earns money automatically. Collect rare symbols, upgrade powerful items, and climb the global leaderboard in this endless progression experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628556/8e65f9942a4e7baa8a3519425a13d484e2fbb0a4.png[/img]

This demo is a sneak peak of Spin Royale, to show you how gameplay works, main mechanic and art of our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628556/ed1aa72cba38b37c1133e3117225dfddca722c80.png[/img]

Play the demo and add the game to your wishlist to support the development of the game!

Family Devs.
